digest.component_or_area: Quality audit remediation (CI reliability, documentation, code structure)
propositions: CI default-suite reliability flake in Python 3.11 xdist worker (test_opcert_service_app) must be resolved or root-caused with a durable fix
User-facing assignee documentation example must teach a Jira-resolvable identity consistent with docs/config.md

Near-cap modules (structured_run.py, compact.py, event_append.py) must be split by responsibility along call-graph seams with public imports preserved, targeting structured_run and compact at ≤500 LOC and event_append at ≤640 LOC

Graph loader/traversal code duplication across _blockers and _compute_dep_graph subsystems must be centralized to reduce cyclomatic complexity of four flagged functions below the max-complexity=15 threshold without altering graph outputs
attest package must pass mypy type checking with --disallow-untyped-defs flag enabled
All new refactoring work must touch only non-contended files to avoid conflicts with in-progress tickets
